q: When was the first law on the old-age pension adopted?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvornår blev den første lov om folkepension vedtaget?

learn.text: So the first old-age pension law came in 1956, and a second followed in 1964.

q: What problems was the Kanslergade Agreement of 1933 meant to solve?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021, November 2022 and May 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvilke problemer i samfundet skulle Kanslergadeforliget fra 1933 især løse?

learn.text: The Kanslergade Agreement was made in 1933, during the economic crisis of the 1930s, so the problem it was meant to solve was economic.
